0022600145.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-4, on a four-game losing streak and 15th in the West) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, on a three-game losing streak and 14th in the West) in a matchup of winless teams, with the Kings 0-2 on the road this season. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise) and Jordan Poole (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Kings won the last meeting 117-113 in Sacramento on April 3, 2026, after losing the 2025-26 season series 1-2.
